info.name: Cardiac Monitor API — Final Sprint 4
info.description: Complete 39-endpoint documentation collection. Examples are illustrative, not recorded executions. Use a disposable database: POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE requests change data. Set a real adminToken, run Authentication then entity folders in order, and obtain a nurseToken for the newly created Nurse before its assigned-patients request. Cleanup runs last. Refresh requires an expired Patient access token and is manual; exclude it from the initial runner execution. Allow a 2500 ms runner delay to respect GeneralPolicy.

exec: for (const kind of ['patient', 'doctor', 'nurse']) if (!pm.environment.get(kind + 'Email')) pm.environment.set(kind + 'Email', kind + '-' + runId + '@example.com');
const tomorrow = new Date(); tomorrow.setUTCDate(tomorrow.getUTCDate() + 1); tomorrow.setUTCHours(10, 0, 0, 0);
